guarantees.claim: When generate block gen_no_prim_flop_ab_y10 (unpipelined multiplier) is active, a_y1_q, a_y0_q, b_y1_q, b_y0_q are forced to all-zero by continuous assignment to prevent any valid masked share value from being consumed downstream.

uncertain_points.claim: Downstream logic that reads these forced-zero signals may inadvertently rely on zero values, potentially causing incorrect masking behavior or revealing that the unpipelined mode is active; must verify that such usage does not create a security vulnerability.
uncertain_points.cond: when gen_no_prim_flop_ab_y10 is active and any downstream module reads a_y1_q, a_y0_q, b_y1_q, or b_y0_q
uncertain_points.risk: If downstream logic expects real share values but receives zeros, masking strength could be reduced, or a fault might go undetected, compromising side‑channel resistance.
